title: Binary-intel packs as Cortex memory branch

claims.text: Binary-intel packs are a Cortex memory branch: install under CORTEX_HOME/packs, zero-in by domain, expand cards when mass coheres.
Teaching fills pack cards and rebuilds CORTEXBF1 routing; it does not copy LLM weights into binary or claim consciousness.
Enter = activate rebind stream + domain zero-in; connect = mesh pulse. Packs feed the same body, not a second mind.
Evolution closes as probe-outcome-ranker-probe-causal; packs evolve by better cards and reinstall, never silent self-promote.
Agent loop: enter → zero-in → evidence → work → remember → seal → optional evolve. Trust source/tests over pack prose.
